03830: function chooseOrder(){
03831:   const e=exState(),types=["capture","kos","shields","triples","hold"];
03832:   let idx=e.orderCount%types.length,type=types[idx];if(type===e.lastOrderType)type=types[(idx+1)%types.length];

03834:   if(type==="capture"){
03835:     const candidates=M.towers.filter(t=>towerLeader(t)!==0).sort((a,b)=>b.pts-a.pts||Math.abs(a.dmg[0]-a.dmg[1])-Math.abs(b.dmg[0]-b.dmg[1]));
03836:     if(!candidates.length)type=o.type="kos";else{o.target=candidates[0].id;o.need=1;o.text=`Take Tower ${candidates[0].name} (${candidates[0].pts}♛)`;}
03837:   }
03838:   if(type==="kos"){o.base=M.tally[0].kos;o.need=2;o.text="Score 2 guild knockouts";}
03839:   if(type==="shields"){o.base=M.tally[0].shields;o.need=4;o.text="Break 4 enemy shields";}
03840:   if(type==="triples"){o.base=teamTriples(0);o.need=3;o.text="Roll 3 guild triples";}
03841:   if(type==="hold"){o.need=15;o.heldMs=0;o.text="Hold 2 valuable towers for 15s";}
03842:   e.order=o;e.orderCount++;e.lastOrderType=type;e.nextOrderAt=now+EXC_ORDER_INTERVAL;

03844: }
03845: function orderProgress(o,now){
03846:   if(o.type==="capture")return towerLeader(M.towers[o.target])===0?1:0;
03847:   if(o.type==="kos")return Math.max(0,M.tally[0].kos-o.base);
03848:   if(o.type==="shields")return Math.max(0,M.tally[0].shields-o.base);
03849:   if(o.type==="triples")return Math.max(0,teamTriples(0)-o.base);
03850:   if(o.type==="hold"){
03851:     const dt=Math.max(0,Math.min(500,now-(o.lastCheck||now)));o.lastCheck=now;
03852:     const held=M.towers.filter(t=>t.pts>=2&&towerLeader(t)===0).length;
03853:     if(held>=2)o.heldMs=(o.heldMs||0)+dt;
03854:     return Math.floor((o.heldMs||0)/1000);
03855:   }
03856:   return 0;
03857: }

02652:     if (screen==='battle'){ resize(); if (M) draw(nowPerf); }
02653:     if (QTE) qteTick(nowPerf);
02654:   } catch (e) {
02655:     const msg = String(e && e.message || e); if (msg !== lastErr){ lastErr = msg; console.error(e); feed(`Error: ${msg}`, 'flip bad'); toast(`Error: ${msg.slice(0,80)}`); }
02656:     anim = null; rollBusy(false);
02657:   }
02658:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
02659: }
02660: addEventListener('error', e => { const msg = e.message || 'script error'; if (msg !== lastErr){ lastErr = msg; feed(`Error: ${msg}`, 'flip bad'); toast(`Error: ${msg.slice(0,80)}`); } });
02661: 
02662: // ---------- daily boss: one boss per day, the whole clan chips at one health pool ----------
02663: // Mechanics: 3 timed attempts a day · armour (Shield rolls break it, damage is halved while it stands) · a weak face that hits double ·
02664: // stagger meter (fill it → 8 s of ×3 damage) · telegraphed boss strikes you parry by tapping the boss (miss → you take a hit; KO ends the attempt) ·
02665: // phases at 66% / 33% speed the strikes up and phase 3 makes the boss take +25%. Rewards: scaled personal tiers, clan milestones, qualified clear bonus, and smaller placement tokens next day.
02666: const BOSS_NAMES = [ ['Gorr the Ravager','barb',4], ['Ser Malachai','knight',3], ['The Archmage Vel','mage',5], ['Nightshade','rogue',1], ['Warden Ashk','ranger',7] ];
02667: const BOSS_TIERS = [ [0.03,150,2,10], [0.08,250,3,15], [0.15,350,4,15], [0.25,450,5,20] ];   // fraction of max HP, gold, tokens, XP
02668: const bossTierNeed = (B,f) => Math.max(1000,Math.round(B.max*f));
02669: const BOSS_ATTEMPTS = 3, BOSS_RUN_MS = 90000, BOSS_ARMOR = 4;
02670: let bossEnt = null, BR = null;   // BR: the live attempt
02671: function bossHash(){ let h = 7; for (const ch of dayKey()) h = (h*33 + ch.charCodeAt(0)) >>> 0; return h; }
02672: function bossCheck(){
02673:   const today = dayKey();
02674:   if (SAVE.boss && SAVE.boss.date === today) return SAVE.boss;
02675:   // yesterday's boss settles: clan placing pays tokens on your next visit
02676:   if (SAVE.boss && SAVE.boss.clan){ const rows = Object.entries(SAVE.boss.clan).map(([n,d])=>({n,d})); rows.push({ n:'You', d:SAVE.boss.dmg, me:true }); rows.sort((a,b)=>b.d-a.d);
02677:     const place = rows.findIndex(r=>r.me) + 1, tk = SAVE.boss.dmg <= 0 ? 0 : place===1 ? 5 : place<=3 ? 3 : place<=10 ? 2 : 1;
02678:     if (tk) SAVE.bossPending = { name: SAVE.boss.name, place, tk, killed: SAVE.boss.killed }; }
02679:   const h = bossHash(), pick = BOSS_NAMES[h % BOSS_NAMES.length], ci = CHARS.findIndex(c=>c.id===pick[1]);
02680:   const lvl = Math.max(5, SAVE.level||5), max = 32000 + 2500*lvl;
02681:   const clan = {}; NAMES.slice(1,20).forEach(n=>{ clan[n] = Math.round(max*(0.05 + ((h*31 + n.charCodeAt(0)*7)%100)/100*0.10)/19*4); });   // the clan has already been at it
02682:   const already = Object.values(clan).reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);
02683:   SAVE.boss = { date: today, name: pick[0], char: ci, weapon: pick[2], weak: (h>>3)%2 ? 'C' : 'S', max, hp: max - already, armor: BOSS_ARMOR, dmg:0, attempts:0, tiers:[], killed:false, killer:null, clan, stagger:0 };
02684:   persist(); return SAVE.boss;
02685: }
02686: function bossEntity(){ const B = bossCheck(); if (!bossEnt || bossEnt.name !== B.name){ bossEnt = { id:'boss', name:B.name, side:1, char:B.char, weapon:B.weapon, level:30, hp:B.hp, maxHp:B.max, shields:0, damage:0, kos:0, rolls:0, shieldsBroken:0, downUntil:0, tower:null }; }
02687:   bossEnt.hp = B.hp; bossEnt.maxHp = B.max; bossEnt.downUntil = B.killed ? Infinity : 0; return bossEnt; }
02688: const bossPhase = B => B.hp <= B.max/3 ? 3 : B.hp <= B.max*2/3 ? 2 : 1;
02689: function renderBossBtn(){
02690:   const B = bossCheck(), b = $('bossBtn'); if (!M) { b.hidden = true; return; } b.hidden = false; b.classList.toggle('dead', B.killed);
02691:   const pct = Math.max(0, B.hp/B.max*100);
02692:   b.innerHTML = `<span class="skull">${B.killed ? '🏆' : '💀'}</span><span><span>DAILY BOSS · ${B.name}</span><small>${B.killed ? 'Slain today — rewards claimed' : `${pct.toFixed(0)}% HP · weak to ${B.weak==='C'?'Crits':'Swords'} · ${BOSS_ATTEMPTS-B.attempts} attempt${BOSS_ATTEMPTS-B.attempts===1?'':'s'} left`}</small><span class="hpb"><i style="width:${pct}%"></i></span></span><span class="go">${B.killed ? 'VIEW' : 'FIGHT'}</span>`;
02693: }
02694: $('bossBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{ SFX.tap(); openBossLobby(); });
02695: function openBossLobby(){
02696:   const B = bossCheck(), phase = bossPhase(B), pct = Math.max(0, B.hp/B.max*100), left = BOSS_ATTEMPTS - B.attempts;
02697:   const rows = Object.entries(B.clan).map(([n,d])=>({n,d})); rows.push({ n:'You', d:B.dmg, me:true }); rows.sort((a,b)=>b.d-a.d);
02698:   const meAt = rows.findIndex(r=>r.me), from = Math.max(0, Math.min(rows.length-4, meAt-1));
02699:   $('bossPanel').innerHTML = `<h2>${B.name}</h2><p style="margin:2px 0 8px">Daily boss · the whole clan hits one health pool · resets at midnight. <span class="tokens">⬢ ${SAVE.tokens} tokens</span></p>
02700:     <div class="bossart"><canvas id="bossArt" width="300" height="300" style="width:150px;height:150px"></canvas></div>
02701:     <div class="hpbar"><i style="width:${pct}%"></i><span>${fmtK(Math.max(0,B.hp))} / ${fmtK(B.max)} · phase ${phase}</span></div>
02702:     <div class="mech"><div><b>Weak face: ${B.weak==='C'?'Crit':'Swords'}</b><small>pairs and triples of it hit ×2</small></div><div><b>Armour ${'▮'.repeat(B.armor)}${'▯'.repeat(BOSS_ARMOR-B.armor)}</b><small>Shield rolls break it · halves damage while up</small></div>
02703:       <div><b>Stagger</b><small>deal 3% of max HP in one attempt → 8 s of ×3</small></div><div><b>Parry</b><small>tap the boss when it winds up, or eat the hit</small></div></div>
02704:     <h3 style="font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.06em;margin:6px 0 2px">YOUR DAMAGE · ${fmt(B.dmg)}</h3>
02705:     <div class="tiers">${BOSS_TIERS.map(([frac,gold,tk,xp],i)=>{ const need=bossTierNeed(B,frac),done=B.tiers.includes(i); return `<div class="tier ${done?'on':''}"><div><b>${fmtK(need)} damage</b><small>${gold} gold · ${tk} tokens · ${xp} XP</small></div><span class="tag ${done?'eq':'q'}">${done?'✓':Math.min(100,Math.round(B.dmg/need*100))+'%'}</span></div>`; }).join('')}
02706:       <div class="tier ${B.killed?'on':''}"><div><b>Kill bonus</b><small>deal at least 2% max HP: 1 chest + 5 tokens + 90 XP · last hit: Slayer title</small></div><span class="tag ${B.killed?'eq':'q'}">${B.killed ? (B.killer==='You' ? 'SLAYER' : '✓') : '—'}</span></div></div>
02707:     <h3 style="font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.06em;margin:6px 0 2px">CLAN MILESTONES · paid to everyone</h3>
02708:     <div class="tiers">${BOSS_MILESTONES.map(([f,gold,tk,shards,pts],i)=>{ const done = (B.milestones||[]).includes(i); return `<div class="tier ${done?'on':''}"><div><b>${Math.round(f*100)}% of ${fmtK(B.max)}</b><small>${gold} gold · ${tk} tokens · ${shards} shards · ${pts} season pt${pts>1?'s':''}</small></div><span class="tag ${done?'eq':'q'}">${done?'✓':'🎁'}</span></div>`; }).join('')}</div>
02709:     <h3 style="font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.06em;margin:6px 0 2px">CLAN · placement tomorrow: 5 / 3 / 2 / 1 tokens</h3>
02710:     <div class="clan">${rows.slice(from, from+4).map((r,i)=>`<div class="${r.me?'me':''}"><span>#${from+i+1}</span><span>${r.n}</span><span>${fmtK(r.d)}</span></div>`).join('')}</div>
02711:     <div class="btns"><button class="go red" id="bossGo" ${B.killed || !left ? 'disabled' : ''}>${B.killed ? 'Slain' : left ? `Fight · ${left} left` : 'No attempts left'}</button><button class="go" id="bossBack">Back</button></div>`;
02712:   // portrait: boss model drawn large

00695:   <div class="panel light">
00696:     <h2>How towers score</h2><p><b>Roll odds:</b> ordinary rolls have a 15% triple, 55% pair, and 30% no-match chance. Every roll throws all three dice; dice locking and combat rerolls are removed. HOT and Shadowstrike apply their stated bonuses. Paid war rolls grant 1 XP per energy actually spent; gold is currency only and no longer grants XP.</p>
00697:     <p><b>Shields:</b> three slots per hero. Each shield absorbs a base sword-pair hit, scaled by its earning multiplier. Stronger shields replace the weakest; excess damage carries through.</p><p><b>Battle rewards:</b> make at least 5 paid rolls during the 5-minute battle. Completion energy is limited to 20 daily; the final minute also has a separate 3-energy rally gift, once per day. Rampage never recharges itself, and ultimate charge is capped at 10 per roll.</p>
00698:     <p><b class="blue">Damage decides it.</b> Every hit your guild lands at a tower — on the garrison, or on the tower itself once the garrison is wiped — adds to your damage total there. The guild with the higher total <b>holds</b> the tower. A tie holds for nobody.</p>
00699:     <p><b class="gold">Held towers are your score.</b> Courtyard towers are worth 3♛, camp towers 2♛, outposts 1♛. Control during the first 4 minutes is banked as your average held tower score. Final tower ownership counts double. Attacks deal ×1.15 from 2:00–4:00 and ×1.5 in the final minute. A regulation tie goes to up to 60 seconds of sudden death; guild damage breaks a tie if overtime expires.</p>
00700:     <p><b class="orange">Siege.</b> When every defender at a tower is down, the knockout that wipes them <b>breaches</b> the tower (a chunk of tower damage banked instantly), and your rolls then hit the tower's score directly at <b>120%</b> — undefended walls — until someone respawns. No KOs or loot during a siege, but it's the fastest scoring in the game, so clear garrisons and pile on.</p>
00701:     <button class="go green" id="shOk">GOT IT</button>
00702:   </div>
00703: </div>

00694: <div class="overlay" id="scoreHelp" hidden>
00695:   <div class="panel light">
00696:     <h2>How towers score</h2><p><b>Roll odds:</b> ordinary rolls have a 15% triple, 55% pair, and 30% no-match chance. Every roll throws all three dice; dice locking and combat rerolls are removed. HOT and Shadowstrike apply their stated bonuses. Paid war rolls grant 1 XP per energy actually spent; gold is currency only and no longer grants XP.</p>
00697:     <p><b>Shields:</b> three slots per hero. Each shield absorbs a base sword-pair hit, scaled by its earning multiplier. Stronger shields replace the weakest; excess damage carries through.</p><p><b>Battle rewards:</b> make at least 5 paid rolls during the 5-minute battle. Completion energy is limited to 20 daily; the final minute also has a separate 3-energy rally gift, once per day. Rampage never recharges itself, and ultimate charge is capped at 10 per roll.</p>
00698:     <p><b class="blue">Damage decides it.</b> Every hit your guild lands at a tower — on the garrison, or on the tower itself once the garrison is wiped — adds to your damage total there. The guild with the higher total <b>holds</b> the tower. A tie holds for nobody.</p>
00699:     <p><b class="gold">Held towers are your score.</b> Courtyard towers are worth 3♛, camp towers 2♛, outposts 1♛. Control during the first 4 minutes is banked as your average held tower score. Final tower ownership counts double. Attacks deal ×1.15 from 2:00–4:00 and ×1.5 in the final minute. A regulation tie goes to up to 60 seconds of sudden death; guild damage breaks a tie if overtime expires.</p>
00700:     <p><b class="orange">Siege.</b> When every defender at a tower is down, the knockout that wipes them <b>breaches</b> the tower (a chunk of tower damage banked instantly), and your rolls then hit the tower's score directly at <b>120%</b> — undefended walls — until someone respawns. No KOs or loot during a siege, but it's the fastest scoring in the game, so clear garrisons and pile on.</p>
00701:     <button class="go green" id="shOk">GOT IT</button>
00702:   </div>

Completion energy is limited to 20 daily; the final minute also has a separate 3-energy rally gift, once per day. Rampage never recharges itself, and ultimate charge is capped at 10 per roll.</p>
00698:     <p><b class="blue">Damage decides it.</b> Every hit your guild lands at a tower — on the garrison, or on the tower itself once the garrison is wiped — adds to your damage total there. The guild with the higher total <b>holds</b> the tower. A tie holds for nobody.</p>
00699:     <p><b class="gold">Held towers are your score.</b> Courtyard towers are worth 3♛, camp towers 2♛, outposts 1♛. Control during the first 4 minutes is banked as your average held tower score. Final tower ownership counts double. Attacks deal ×1.15 from 2:00–4:00 and ×1.5 in the final minute. A regulation tie goes to up to 60 seconds of sudden death; guild damage breaks a tie if overtime expires.</p>
00700:     <p><b class="orange">Siege.</b> When every defender at a tower is down, the knockout that wipes them <b>breaches</b> the tower (a chunk of tower damage banked instantly), and your rolls then hit the tower's score directly at <b>120%</b> — undefended walls — until someone respawns. No KOs or loot during a siege, but it's the fastest scoring in the game, so clear garrisons and pile on.</p>
00701:     <button class="go green" id="shOk">GOT IT</button>

00810: // Six symbols, two faces each on every d12. Match-3: a pair triggers the action, a triple upgrades it (Model C).
00811: const R = {
00812:   FACES: ['S','S','C','C','H','H','G','G','F','F','E','E'],
00813:   get ENERGY_CAP(){ return SAVE.cap || 50; }, REGEN_MS: 10*60*1000,
00814:   OVERTIME_MS: 60000, HEAT_BUFF_AT: 5, HEAT_HOT_AT: 10, HOLD_MS: 650, LOOT_CHANCE: 0.15, SIEGE: 1.2, BREACH: 0.15,   // siege: attacks on a wiped garrison hit the tower score at 120% (undefended walls); breach: wiping a garrison banks 15% of its max HP as tower damage
00815:   HP_MULT: 60, KO_MS: 45000, RESPAWN_SHIELDS: 0, MAX_SHIELDS: 3,
00816:   UNITS: { none:1, pair:2, triple:5 }, SPLASH: 0.25,
00817:   GOLD: { none:5, pair:25, triple:200 }, ENERGY: { pair:1, triple:5 },
00818:   RALLY_MS: 60000, RALLY_STEP: 0.1, RALLY_CAP: 2, RALLIES: 2, RALLY_CD_MS: 180000,
00819:   BOT_ROLLS_PER_MIN: 60, PER_TOWER: 2,     // baseline bot pacing; live guild battles scale this by phase
00820:   atk(level){ return 10 + 2*level; },
00821:   hp(level){ return R.HP_MULT * R.atk(level); },
00822:   critMult(level){ return 2 + Math.min(3,0.1*level); },
00823:   xpNeed(level){ return 60 + 30*level; },
00824:   TRIPLE_CHANCE: .15, PAIR_CHANCE: .55,
00825:   rollFaces(rng){
00826:     const symbols=['S','C','H','G','E','F'], bucket=rng();
00827:     const take=()=>symbols.splice(Math.floor(rng()*symbols.length),1)[0];

00695:   <div class="panel light">
00696:     <h2>How towers score</h2><p><b>Roll odds:</b> ordinary rolls have a 15% triple, 55% pair, and 30% no-match chance. Every roll throws all three dice; dice locking and combat rerolls are removed. HOT and Shadowstrike apply their stated bonuses. Paid war rolls grant 1 XP per energy actually spent; gold is currency only and no longer grants XP.</p>
00697:     <p><b>Shields:</b> three slots per hero. Each shield absorbs a base sword-pair hit, scaled by its earning multiplier. Stronger shields replace the weakest; excess damage carries through.</p><p><b>Battle rewards:</b> make at least 5 paid rolls during the 5-minute battle. Completion energy is limited to 20 daily; the final minute also has a separate 3-energy rally gift, once per day. Rampage never recharges itself, and ultimate charge is capped at 10 per roll.</p>
00698:     <p><b class="blue">Damage decides it.</b> Every hit your guild lands at a tower — on the garrison, or on the tower itself once the garrison is wiped — adds to your damage total there. The guild with the higher total <b>holds</b> the tower. A tie holds for nobody.</p>
00699:     <p><b class="gold">Held towers are your score.</b> Courtyard towers are worth 3♛, camp towers 2♛, outposts 1♛. Control during the first 4 minutes is banked as your average held tower score. Final tower ownership counts double. Attacks deal ×1.15 from 2:00–4:00 and ×1.5 in the final minute. A regulation tie goes to up to 60 seconds of sudden death; guild damage breaks a tie if overtime expires.</p>
00700:     <p><b class="orange">Siege.</b> When every defender at a tower is down, the knockout that wipes them <b>breaches</b> the tower (a chunk of tower damage banked instantly), and your rolls then hit the tower's score directly at <b>120%</b> — undefended walls — until someone respawns. No KOs or loot during a siege, but it's the fastest scoring in the game, so clear garrisons and pile on.</p>
